THE STORY
Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

MOTION SPEC
Film-strip advance, Frame 01 → 02
01 · Trailer (leaving)
↑ 720 ms
02 · Verdict (docks)
Content · normal scroll
TICKET BAR · DOCKED
Trigger
One scroll notch, drag or swipe advances exactly one frame (Frame 01 → 02). Content below the Verdict scrolls normally: no scroll-jacking for reading.
Strip move
Strip translates by one frame height. 720 ms, cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .2, 1). Outgoing frame scales to 0.96 and dims 45%.
Type
Title glyphs roll in, staggered 18 ms each, like siena.film. Scores and quotes fade up 120 ms after the frame settles.
Trailer
Autoplays muted only while ≥ 50% of Frame 01 is visible. Pauses when it leaves. Sound is always user-initiated.
Docking
As Frame 01 exits, the ticket bar slides down (240 ms): poster, both scores, chapters, Rent CTA.
Reduced motion
prefers-reduced-motion: no snapping, no glyph roll, 150 ms crossfades, trailer shows a still frame.
